decisions.reason: The mechanical-layout impact is already fully represented by its existing message-72 MODIFY, including fit, connector spacing, and mounting-hole clearance.
Connector placement, spacing, and mounting-hole clearance do not change the battery-protection requirements.
The source decision does not change the required battery NTC connection or temperature-sensing method.
The source concerns the battery-connector arrangement beside the board JST, not the USB-C connector or its sourceability.
The battery-connector layout constraints do not alter the charge-status indicator, GPIO, or separate-LED rule.
The source decision does not affect boost-converter enable control, pull-down resistance, or powered-load behavior.
The mechanical constraints on the battery connectors do not change the TVS-based ESD-protection requirement.
The battery-connector arrangement has no necessary effect on I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source sets physical fit and clearance constraints but makes no component-availability or sourcing decision.
